user_stories.story: As a Staff Member, I want a centralized Document Library, so that I can find official company documents.
acceptance_criteria: Users can view documents they have access to.
Documents can be categorized and tagged.
Search functionality filters by content and metadata.

user_stories.story: As a Policy Owner, I want to draft and edit Policies directly in the platform, so that we have a single source of truth.
acceptance_criteria: Owner can create a Policy with a rich text editor.
Owner can upload extensive policy documents (PDF/Word) which are parsed.

user_stories.story: As a Policy Owner, I want to link Policies to specific Regulations and Controls, so that I can show coverage.
acceptance_criteria: Owner can link a Policy to a Regulation.
Owner can link a Policy to a Compliance Control.

user_stories.story: As a Reviewer, I want to approve or reject documents via a workflow, so that quality is maintained.
acceptance_criteria: Documents can be submitted for review.
Designated approvers can Approve or Request Changes.

user_stories.story: As a User, I want to access Policy Management from my organization dashboard, so that I don't need admin access.
acceptance_criteria: Standard users see 'Policy Management' in the sidebar (gated by feature flag).
Tenant-scoped view ensures no cross-org data leakage.
